consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1988-06-19 show at Alpine Valley had solid performances with some standout moments, particularly the debut of 'Foolish Heart.' While the heat and crowd dynamics were challenging, many felt the energy of the show was strong and memorable.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 29 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans enjoyed the show and highlighted specific songs, there were notable criticisms regarding the heat and crowd behavior that tempered overall enthusiasm.
